_note: Override list, deliberately MINIMAL. It holds only names the generated chain-index misses - typically chains OSM undercounts inside the Metro Manila bbox, or short/long name variants that normalize apart (e.g. "Seattle's Best" counts 4 while "Seattle's Best Coffee" counts 24). Anything the index already catches is removed on purpose: keeping it here would obscure which mechanism is doing the work. Re-prune after each chain-index rebuild.
